curation.lead:
Ghislaine Noelle Maxwell (born December 25, 1961) is a British socialite and the only co-conspirator of Jeffrey Epstein ever charged by federal prosecutors [Connection #1522][Connection #1932]. Florida Sun-Biz records show that in April 1995 Epstein incorporated GHISLAINE CORP. (FL P95000027272, EIN 65-0590904) at 358 El Brillo Way, Palm Beach, naming himself as registered agent and president and operating it from the same address as his FINANCIAL STRATEGY GROUP INC.; the entity was voluntarily dissolved in October 1998, a 3.5-year span that overlaps with the period investigators later identified as the operational core of the Epstein enterprise [Finding #515]. From 1995 to 2020, TransUnion address records place Maxwell at the 116 East 65th Street townhouse in Manhattan, a property whose ownership was held by Epstein associate Darren Indyke and which Maxwell sold for approximately fifteen million dollars in April 2016 [Finding #1346][Connection #1137][Connection #895].

Maxwell's documented role within the enterprise spans corporate, financial, and operational layers [Connection #1014][Finding #1346][EFTA01524286]. A June 2003 trust amendment recorded in the Epstein Files Tranche A installed her as co-trustee of "2001 Trust One," replacing Jeffrey A. Schantz [Connection #1014][Connection #1021]. Court filings in Giuffre v. Maxwell state that she remained a signatory on Epstein's Palm Beach household bank account as recently as 2005 [Finding #1346]. In January 2006, Forums LLC executed a $220,000 internal funds transfer to Maxwell's JPMorgan Private Bank checking account [EFTA01524286][Connection #1881]. FEC records show three federal political contributions totaling $4,300 to Hillary Clinton for President in 2007 (paired with donations from Richard Kahn and other Epstein-network donors) and $2,000 to King for Congress in New Mexico in 2004, made jointly with Indyke from a St. Thomas address during the period of Epstein's Zorro Ranch operations [Finding #451][FEC:C00431569][FEC:C00393702].

A December 8, 2009 email from Maxwell to Epstein, recovered in the Epstein Files Tranche A, reads: "If you call I would start by saying what ever you saw was fake and part of a blackmail scheme," advising Epstein on how to characterize compromising material [EFTA02434764][Finding #531]. Maxwell was arrested in New Hampshire on July 2, 2020 -- two weeks after Attorney General William Barr moved to remove SDNY U.S. Attorney Geoffrey Berman -- and was convicted in December 2021 on five counts including sex trafficking of minors [Connection #1522][Connection #1932]. She is the founder of the dissolved TerraMar Project ocean-conservation nonprofit and remains the sole director and Person of Significant Control of Ellmax Enterprise Limited (UK Companies House 08321238) [Finding #4905].
curation.system_role: Maxwell occupies a documented operational position within Epstein's network spanning corporate trusteeship, household financial control, political fundraising, and direct supervision of victims, illustrating how a single individual can serve simultaneously as fiduciary, social broker, and on-site manager across multiple jurisdictions of an ostensibly private financial enterprise.

sections.title: Operational Role
sections.content:
Maxwell's involvement extended beyond social proximity into corporate and fiduciary control of Jeffrey Epstein's structures [Finding #515][Connection #1014][Finding #1346]. Florida Sun-Biz filings record that GHISLAINE CORP. (FL P95000027272, EIN 65-0590904) was incorporated on April 3, 1995 at 358 El Brillo Way, Palm Beach, with Epstein as both registered agent and president/director and Amanda J. Ellison as secretary; the entity was named by amendment on April 21, 1995 and voluntarily dissolved on October 23, 1998 [Finding #515][REG:FL:P95000027272]. The same address simultaneously housed Epstein's FINANCIAL STRATEGY GROUP INC. (FL P93000087814) [Finding #515][REG:FL:P93000087814].

A First Amendment to Trust Agreement filed in June 2003 named Maxwell as co-trustee of the 2001 Trust One, replacing prior co-trustee Jeffrey A. Schantz [EFTA01266298][Connection #1014][Connection #1021]. Court filings in Giuffre v. Maxwell, with Bates reference SAO FOIA disc 7 (Giuffre 007590) at pages 93-95, state that Maxwell remained a signatory on Epstein's Palm Beach household bank account as recently as 2005 [Finding #1346]. In January 2006, Forums LLC executed a $220,000 internal funds transfer into Maxwell's JPMorgan Private Bank checking account, documented in EFTA01524286 [Connection #1881][EFTA01524286].

Maxwell's awareness of compromising material is documented in a December 8, 2009 email from her "Gmax" account to Epstein recovered in the Epstein Files Tranche A: "If you call I would start by saying what ever you saw was fake and part of a blackmail scheme" [EFTA02434764][Finding #531]. The 2016 deposition of victims described in DOCUMENTCLOUD:24402696 names Lesley Groff and Natalya Malyshev among Epstein personnel referenced in the same proceeding [Connection #649][Connection #650]. Civil filings in Priscilla Doe v. Epstein describe Maxwell providing direct on-site instruction to victims at Little Saint James in 2006 [Finding #3209][Connection #1935].

sections.title: Property and Corporate Holdings
sections.content:
Maxwell's principal residence from 1995 to 2020 was the Manhattan townhouse at 116 East 65th Street, confirmed by TransUnion records [EFTA01654657][Connection #1137]. The property's ownership trail runs through Darren Indyke, Epstein's longtime attorney, who is identified in LexisNexis records as a person associate at the same address from 2008 to 2015 [EFTA01295770][Connection #895]. Maxwell sold the townhouse for approximately fifteen million dollars in April 2016 (NYPost, April 2016) [Finding #1346]. NYC ACRIS contains no records under any Maxwell name variant searched, consistent with the property having been held in another name during her occupancy [Finding #496][ACRIS:Maxwell-search].

GRM Box #004740715 in the Epstein document holdings catalogues a "Ghislaine Maxwell & 65th Street" file containing the Sotheby's brokerage agreement for the sale of her house, correspondence between Epstein staff and Diandra Douglas regarding construction damage to the property, and a letter to Herb Wolman concerning AIG payment for services of Miller & Raved; the same box holds the Pot and Kettle LLC Certificate of Formation, Certificate of Conversion, and Assignment of Limited Partnership Interest signed by Maxwell and the Duke of York [EFTA00300480][Finding #2513][Connection #1239]. Adjacent box GRM #004740714, item 9, references UK Land Registry materials and information on Eaton Square Properties and Mrs. Paula Cussi de Azcarraga [EFTA00300480].

UK Companies House records list Maxwell as sole director, secretary, and Person of Significant Control of Ellmax Enterprise Limited (08321238), registered to Orchard End, Fittleton; as a director of TerraMar Project UK Limited (08661523) alongside Lucy Clive and Catherine Vaughan-Edwards; and as a director of Jemma Kidd Make-Up Limited (05340072), with the registered address for the Jemma Kidd directorship listed as 6100 Red Hook Quarters, U.S. Virgin Islands -- a known Epstein address [Finding #4905]. Maxwell is also catalogued as the founder of the New York-registered TerraMar Project nonprofit, which dissolved after Epstein's July 2019 arrest [Finding #4905].

sections.title: Political Contributions and Legal Defense Funding
sections.content:
FEC Schedule A filings record three federal contributions from Maxwell [Finding #451]. On March 30, 2007, she gave $2,300 to Hillary Clinton for President (committee C00431569), filed with employer listed as "NOT EMPLOYED" and address as New York, NY 10022 [FEC:C00431569][Finding #451]. On September 1, 2004 she made two $1,000 contributions to King for Congress (committee C00393702) for New Mexico congressional candidate Gary King, filed with employer listed as "RETIRED" and address as St. Thomas, U.S. Virgin Islands [FEC:C00393702][Finding #451].

Maxwell and Darren Indyke were the only Epstein-network donors identified in FEC filings to King for Congress, both giving from St. Thomas during the operational period of Epstein's Zorro Ranch in New Mexico [FEC:C00393702][Connection #345][Finding #451]. Maxwell's $2,300 Clinton contribution is paired in committee C00431569 with contributions from Richard Kahn ($2,300, June 6, 2007) and Anthony Barrett ($1,000, June 20, 2007), the latter the manager of the Epstein family's Ossa Properties entity [FEC:C00431569][Connection #346][Connection #347].

Outbound legal-defense expenditure related to Maxwell is documented in the Epstein Files Tranche A email corpus [EFTA02484900]. In October 2015, Latham & Watkins partner Kathryn Ruemmler -- former White House Counsel -- forwarded a $50,000 legal-defense retainer request for Maxwell to Epstein and discussed media strategy concerning Maxwell and the Duke of York [EFTA02484900][EFTA02651512][Connection #11].

sections.title: Social and Institutional Network
sections.content:
Outside the Epstein household, Maxwell maintained a documented social and institutional footprint that intersected with British royalty, philanthropy, and the United Nations system [Connection #1239][Connection #2275][Connection #91]. The Pot and Kettle LLC Assignment of Limited Partnership Interest catalogued in GRM Box #004740715 carries the signatures of Maxwell and the Duke of York, Prince Andrew, indicating a shared corporate vehicle [EFTA00300480][Connection #1239]. EFTA01249207 records Maxwell and Sarah Ferguson attending the Dolce Vita Parties, which raised funds for Children In Crisis and Stow School [EFTA01249207][Connection #2275].

On June 20, 2013, Maxwell co-organized a United Nations event on oceans and Sustainable Development Goals at the UN Conference Building with Amir Dossal of the Global Partnership Forum and Stuart Beck, then ambassador for Palau, in Maxwell's capacity as founder of the TerraMar Project [EFTA02707132][Connection #91]. Masha Drokova served as an advisor to TerraMar; Drokova co-founded the WE Talks webinar series with Lana Pozhidaeva, an Epstein assistant, using trademark paperwork filed by Epstein's lawyer [EFTA02445716][Connection #515].

Telephone and contact records situate Maxwell as a connector across the broader network [EFTA02332924][EFTA02332968]. EFTA02332924 logs an April 27, 2004 phone call from Abe Gosman to Maxwell; Gosman was the previous owner of Maison de L'Amitie, the Palm Beach estate that Trump Properties LLC subsequently purchased out of Gosman's bankruptcy [Connection #295]. EFTA02332968 records Maxwell distributing the Colony Capital contact information for Tom Barrack in August 2004, identifying her as the original connector between Barrack and the Epstein circle [EFTA02332968][Connection #1398].

sections.title: Legal Proceedings
sections.content:
Maxwell appears as a defendant or material witness across multiple proceedings spanning two decades [CL:11742516][Finding #1319][Finding #3209]. In 2002-2003 she and Les Wexner were co-defendants in SHANKS v. WEXNER (E.D. Pa. 2:02-cv-07671), a breach-of-contract action [CL:11742516][Connection #679]. In her 2016 deposition, recorded in DOCUMENTCLOUD:24402693, Maxwell stated under oath that "the allegations that Clinton had a meal on Jeffrey's island is 100 percent false," while confirming "I'm sure he had a meal on Jeffrey's plane," and acknowledged knowing Clinton aide Doug Band; asked about her relationship with Band she stated, "We are talking about adult consensual relationships, it's off the record" [Finding #1319]. A September 2002 flight log entry referenced in DOCUMENTCLOUD:24402695 names passengers "President Clinton, Kevin Spacey, Chris Tucker, Jeffrey Epstein and the initials GM," and Maxwell was asked at deposition to confirm she remembered traveling with Clinton on that trip [Finding #1351].

Civil filings in Priscilla Doe v. Epstein describe Maxwell providing on-site direction to victims during a 2006 trip to Little Saint James, U.S. Virgin Islands [Finding #3209][Connection #1935]. The complaint in Ali Karimi v. Deutsche Bank describes Maxwell as "an Epstein associate and alleged fixer charged by federal prosecutors" and notes her July 2020 arrest occurred one week before the New York Department of Financial Services announced its $150 million consent order against Deutsche Bank [Connection #1932].

Maxwell was arrested in New Hampshire on July 2, 2020 under Acting U.S. Attorney Audrey Strauss, two weeks after Attorney General William Barr announced on June 19, 2020 that SEC Chair Jay Clayton would be nominated for the SDNY U.S. Attorney post and one day after Barr removed Geoffrey Berman from the position on June 20, 2020 [Connection #1522]. Barr's August 2019 statement that "any co-conspirators should not rest easy" preceded the prosecution; Maxwell remains the only Epstein co-conspirator charged by federal prosecutors [Connection #1522]. She was convicted in December 2021 on five of six counts, including sex trafficking of minors, and is serving a twenty-year sentence at FCI Tallahassee [Connection #1932].

open_questions: Under what name was the 116 East 65th Street townhouse held during Maxwell's 1995-2016 occupancy, given the absence of NYC ACRIS records under any Maxwell variant and Indyke's documented association with the address?
What was the corporate purpose and beneficial ownership of GHISLAINE CORP. (FL P95000027272) during its 1995-1998 existence, and what assets, accounts, or transactions flowed through it?
What was the full membership and operating purpose of Pot and Kettle LLC, jointly signed by Maxwell and the Duke of York, and where are its banking records held?

What were the source funds and business rationale for the $220,000 January 2006 transfer from Forums LLC to Maxwell's JPMorgan Private Bank account, and what other Forums LLC outflows are documented in EFTA01524286?

What internal Department of Justice deliberations connect the June 19-20, 2020 attempted removal of SDNY U.S. Attorney Geoffrey Berman to the timing of Maxwell's July 2, 2020 arrest, and what records exist of Barr's prior 2019 commitments regarding co-conspirators?
